description: Plan (and optionally apply) one workspace, with policy check, plan classification and sticky PR comment

allow_unencrypted_plans.description: true = without a key, a plan saved on a private repository is stored unencrypted without the warning (public repositories never save one)

apply.description: none = plan only | auto = apply per auto_apply rule | force = apply if policy passes

auto_apply.description: never | always | additive_only (used when apply=auto); default never

entry.description: the matrix entry of this workspace as JSON (toJSON(fromJSON(entries)[matrix.label]) from detect-workspaces): name, label, dir, workspace, var_file, parallelism, plan_lock, lock_timeout, auto_apply, policy_dir, policy_packs and policy_params come from it

head_sha.description: PR head SHA that keys the saved plan (empty = no pull request, plan cannot be saved or found)

plan_encryption_key.description: Key used to encrypt saved plans (pass secrets.PLAN_ENCRYPTION_KEY). Empty = stored unencrypted, with a warning.

plan_mode.description: fresh = plan then apply | reviewed = apply the saved PR plan if valid else re-plan | reviewed_only = apply only a valid saved plan

pr_number.description: If set, post/update a sticky PR comment

save_plan.description: true = save the plan as a (encrypted) artifact for a later reviewed apply

name: tofu plan/apply

changes.description: JSON array [{"action": added|changed|deleted|replaced, "address"}] of the planned changes (addresses only, at most 50)

changes_more.description: how many more changed resources there were beyond the 50 listed in changes

counts.description: JSON {"add","change","destroy","replace"} of the plan (replace counts as one add and one destroy); empty when there is no plan

duration.description: seconds the tofu step took (plan, policy and apply)

plan_text.description: the readable plan (clipped like a plan comment) when a plan was made; empty otherwise

reviewed.description: true when a saved, reviewed plan was applied or loaded

status.description: no-changes | planned | applied | skipped | policy-failed | error

steps.name: Remove tofu working files from the runner workspace
steps.run: if [ -n "$DIR" ] && [ -d "$REPO_ROOT/$DIR" ]; then (cd "$REPO_ROOT/$DIR" && rm -rf tfplan plan.json plan.txt show.txt apply.txt init.txt policy.txt .terraform); fi
